_comment: Sample config. The skill creates the real config.json on first run by asking you these questions interactively. Required fields for basic onboarding: brand.name, audience, voice.preset. Carousel-specific fields (carousel.*) are filled in the first time you make a carousel.
audience: Describe your audience in one sentence (e.g., 'small-business owners learning AI').

carousel._comment: Filled in on first carousel use, not during basic onboarding.
carousel.aesthetic: Atmospheric painterly cinematic illustration, muted color palette, dramatic light, textured visible brush strokes
